Frequently Asked Questions

What services does Gondaliya CPA provide for businesses?

We offer a full suite of services including bookkeeping, payroll, tax preparation and planning, CFO advisory, and business incorporation support. Each service can be customized to meet the unique needs of your business.

Why should I hire Gondaliya CPA for my business services?

Our team combines professional expertise with affordable, personalized service. We help businesses stay compliant, save on taxes, and make smarter financial decisions.

Can you assist small businesses with bookkeeping and accounting?

Yes — we provide cost-effective bookkeeping and accounting solutions for small businesses, including organized recordkeeping, monthly reconciliations, and cloud-based reporting.

What makes Gondaliya CPA different from other accounting firms?

We deliver hands-on support and expert guidance at competitive rates. Clients appreciate our transparent pricing, proactive advice, and commitment to helping businesses succeed.

How does Gondaliya CPA compare to other accountants in terms of cost?

Our clients find that we provide more value for the price. You get personalized support from experienced tax accountants, expert advice, and hands-on guidance without paying premium fees.

What types of businesses do you work with?

We work with businesses of all sizes and industries. Whether you’re a start-up, a small business, or a larger corporation, we can tailor our services to meet your unique needs and goals.

How can your services help my business grow?

We provide financial insights, cash flow management, and strategic planning advice to support smarter business decisions and sustainable growth.

Do you provide audit support if CRA reviews my return?

Yes — we offer FREE audit support for our tax clients. Our CPAs represent you directly with CRA.

Can you help with business incorporation and registration?

Yes — we offer incorporation services, business number registration, and guidance on selecting the right structure for your company.

Can you help reduce my corporate taxes?

Yes — our CPAs identify eligible deductions, credits, and tax planning strategies to reduce your overall tax liability.

How do I get started with Gondaliya CPA services?

You can book a free consultation call directly through our website, or contact us via our Contact Us page, and our team will reach out to discuss your business needs.
